BrochureContent.Content:
Exceptional 5 bedroom detached residence with garage on private site in the Summerhill area of Carrick on Shannon. Turnkey luxury living within walking distance of the town centre. It is rare that a property of this caliber comes to market, particularly one offering such a unique combination of space, privacy, modern finish and prime location. Ideally positioned within a quiet, private cul-de-sac in a mature, residential development, this outstanding home enjoys the best of both worlds - just a short walk to the town centre, yet with a setting that feels peaceful private. Carrick on Shannon is a town that continues to go from strength to strength and is proudly recognized as the recent Tidy Towns winner - this is a superb opportunity to secure a high-quality family home in one of Ireland??s most desirable and well-kept towns. Occupying a private site this impressive four/five bedroom detached residence has been extensively renovated and modernised, combining the solidity of a well-built 1990s cavity wall home with a refined, contemporary interior. Presented in true turnkey condition, the property is ready for immediate occupation and can be offered furnished or unfurnished, providing flexibility for both owner-occupiers and portfolio investors. The accommodation is both generous and beautifully balanced, comprising four spacious bedrooms at first floor level with a fifth bedroom or if required a second reception room at ground floor level. Having a strong B3 BER rating, the property is fully insulated to modern standards and benefits from a recently installed Grant Vortex condensing oil boiler. A 3-zone smart heating system (ground floor, first floor and hot water) ensures optimal efficiency and comfort, all controllable via a mobile app and powered by 1GB high-speed fibre broadband. The property enjoys generous gardens to the front, side and rear, framed by mature lawns and established hedging, providing excellent privacy and a beautifully settled feel. The rear garden is particularly special, featuring two mature apple trees, adding charm and a sense of natural character to this peaceful outdoor space. To the rear is a substantial concrete patio area. The integral garage has power and plumbing and could be converted to further accommodation, subject to the necessary consents. Perfectly positioned off Summerhill, this home is within walking distance of the town centre, a selection of schools, the Aura Leisure Centre, the GAA and Rugby Clubs, Tesco Retail Park, and boasts easy access to the N4. Offering a wonderful blend of convenience, space and comfort, this property is a rare gem in one of the most desirable areas of Carrick-on-Shannon. Set within a quiet cul-de-sac with access to a communal green area, this property offers a safe and established residential setting. Despite its peaceful surroundings, the home is within easy walking distance of Carrick-on-Shannon town centre, delivering a rare blend of convenience and serenity.
